eshram.name: e-Shram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
eshram.benefit: Free e-Shram card (UAN) and a ₹2 lakh accident insurance cover (PMSBY) for the first year for eligible registrants.
manual: You are not a member of EPFO / ESIC (or government-funded NPS)
eshram.apply: Self-register online on the e-Shram portal, or at any Common Service Centre (CSC). No income limit is set for registration.

pmsym.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) pension
pmsym.benefit: Assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60, with matching contribution from the Government.
manual: You are not an income tax payer
You are not a member of EPFO / ESIC / NPS
docs: Savings bank / Jan Dhan account number with IFSC (passbook, cheque book or statement)
pmsym.apply: Enrol at a nearest Common Service Centre using self-certification, or self-register on the PM-SYM portal / app.

pmsby.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
pmsby.benefit: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or full disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability. Premium ₹20 per year (may be revised).
manual: You have a savings bank / post office account and give consent for yearly auto-debit
You enrol through only one account
docs: Savings bank or post office account
pmsby.apply: Apply through your bank or post office branch, or online via the Jan Suraksha portal.

pmjjby.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
pmjjby.benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover on death due to any cause. Premium ₹436 per year (may be revised).
manual: You have a savings bank account and give consent for yearly auto-debit
pmjjby.apply: Apply through your bank branch or the Jan Suraksha portal. Cover can continue to age 55 if you join before 50.

apy.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
apy.benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60, based on the contribution you choose.
manual: You are not, and have not been, an income tax payer (new accounts since 1 Oct 2022)
You have a savings bank account
apy.apply: Open through your bank or post office branch. Monthly contribution depends on the age you join and the pension you choose.

tnwb.name: Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Welfare Boards (includes Domestic Workers Welfare Board)
tnwb.dept: Labour Welfare & Skill Development Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
tnwb.benefit: Board membership with welfare assistance such as accident and disability assistance and pension. Amounts differ by board, so check current rates.
manual: Your occupation is covered by one of the 18 boards (for example domestic work, driving, tailoring, cooking and catering)
docs: Certificate of employment (from employer, trade union or a Labour Department officer)
tnwb.apply: Register on the Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Welfare Board portal or through the District Labour Officer (Social Security Scheme). Registration is for ages 18 to under 60.

pmmvy.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
pmmvy.benefit: ₹5,000 for the first living child (two instalments). ₹6,000 for a second child if she is a girl.
manual: You are pregnant, or registering within 270 days of childbirth
You qualify under at least one category, such as e-Shram card holder, BPL / NFSA ration card, SC/ST, disability of 40% or more, PM-JAY beneficiary, or family income below ₹8 lakh a year
You are not a regular government / PSU employee and not already receiving similar maternity benefit under any law
docs: Proof of the category you qualify under (for example e-Shram card or ration card)
pmmvy.apply: Register through your Anganwadi worker / ASHA, or directly on the PMMVY portal. Registration during pregnancy is mandatory for the second-child girl benefit.

kmut.name: Magalir Urimai Thogai (Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam)
kmut.benefit: ₹1,000 per month to the woman head of the family (as reported for 2026). The scheme is being restructured, so the name and amount may change.
manual: You are the woman head of the family as per the ration card
Your family income is below ₹2.5 lakh a year, you are not an income tax payer, and your family land and household electricity use are within the limits set in the scheme rules
kmut.apply: Apply through the Tamil Nadu government channels announced for the scheme (Taluk / ration shop camps or the state e-services portal).
kmut.caution: Status check: the new state government (2026) says it is restructuring this scheme. Confirm the current name, amount and rules before applying.

trUnavailable: Translation is unavailable right now. Check your internet connection, or install the translation model (see README).
